subject: Post-call recap: Novara procurement gating, MAP & PO timeline
messages:
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: oliver@novara-med.com, priya.reddy@novara-med.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Novara procurement gating, MAP & PO timeline

Oliver / Priya — thanks again for the call today. Short recap and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) so we have alignment on the procurement path and timing. I attached a one-page MAP (Novara-MAP-v1.xlsx).

Key takeaways from discovery:
- You prefer procurement by PO (finance-led), but marketplace (AWS) remains an option if timing requires it.
- Sequence: legal review -> security assessment -> finance (PO issuance).
- Primary internal owners you named: Legal (Priya), Security (Oliver), Finance (TBD, likely procurement ops).

Proposed MAP & milestones (suggested owners & dates) — high level:
1) Contract review (Redwood legal <> Novara legal): owner: Novara (Priya); Redwood owner: Karthik Iyer — target: 2026-07-02
2) Security questionnaire & evidence exchange: owner: Novara security (Oliver) + Redwood CS/Sec — target: 2026-07-09
3) Commercial SOW & pricing confirmation: owner: Redwood (Lauren/Ben) — draft sent 2026-06-23, final by 2026-07-06
4) Finance PO submission and receipt: owner: Novara finance — target: 2026-07-16

Options/notes:
- PO vs Card: PO preferred for contract value; card is feasible for an initial pilot but adds manual reconciliation on your side.
- Marketplace: we can accept Marketplace purchase, but listing/approval adds ~2–4 weeks. Recommend PO for predictable timing; Marketplace as fallback for faster procurement if you need to start pilot sooner.
- Attachments: MAP attached (Novara-MAP-v1.xlsx). I will follow up with a draft SOW and our completed security questionnaire.

Next steps (mutual):
- Novara: confirm whether Finance will issue a PO (who is the finance contact?) and confirm Legal review owner (Priya confirmed).
- Redwood: send draft SOW + security questionnaire output by Tuesday 6/23 — Karthik will coordinate contract redlines.

If this looks good I will send a single-page MAP to circulate internally at Novara and loop in Redwood legal for contract handoff.

Thanks — talk soon.

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: Novara-MAP-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet; MAP with milestones & owners)

From: oliver@novara-med.com
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: priya.reddy@novara-med.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Novara procurement gating, MAP & PO timeline

Lauren — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Legal: Priya will own the legal review. Our internal cadence means a 7–10 business day turnaround if there are no major redlines. Can you confirm Redwood's contracting team contact and who will take the first pass?

2) Security: We run a standard SaaS security assessment. Can you provide your completed questionnaire + SOC2 evidence? Also any notes on data residency (we are US-only for PHI-adjacent workloads).

3) Finance / PO: We will likely issue a standard PO but need the SOW + exact line-item pricing to route it. Do you have a PO-ready quote? If we go Marketplace (AWS), do you already have a listing and procurement id?

4) Timeline: the MAP dates look reasonable. Can you make the SOW and pricing visible to procurement by end of this week? That will let us target a PO the week of 7/13.

Attaching our procurement checklist and preferred PO template for reference.

Oliver Grant
Director, InfoSec & IT Ops
Novara Medical
oliver@novara-med.com
Attachment: Novara-procurement-questions.pdf (procurement checklist & PO template)

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: oliver@novara-med.com, priya.reddy@novara-med.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Novara procurement gating, MAP & PO timeline

Thanks Oliver — good questions. Quick answers and artifacts attached.

1) Contracting: Redwood will take the first pass with a standard MSA + SOW. Internal point: Karthik Iyer (karthik.iyer@redwood.com) will drive contract edits and be the primary Redwood legal liaison. Expect the first draft on Thursday 6/25; goal is to keep redlines minimal.

2) Security: attached is our completed short-form security questionnaire and SOC2 snapshot (security-questionnaire-completed.pdf). We host customer data in US regions only; we'll include the minimal data residency language in the SOW. If you need an encrypted-at-rest addendum, we can include that as an SLA appendix.

3) Commercial / PO readiness: attached is a draft SOW and pricing summary (Redwood-SOW-draft.pdf). Line items are formatted for direct PO ingestion. If you confirm finance contact, we can produce a formal quote with your PO number.

4) Marketplace: we currently support AWS Marketplace purchases, but note that listing approval and marketplace procurement lead time can extend the schedule by 2–4 weeks. If speed-to-pilot is critical, we can split: start a small pilot on a short-term credit card or invoice while PO gets processed for broader usage.

Updated MAP with owners & suggested due dates (attached in MAP v1 and summarized here):
- 2026-07-02: Novara legal first review complete (owner: Priya Reddy)
- 2026-07-09: Security Q + evidence accepted (owner: Oliver Grant)
- 2026-07-06: Final SOW & pricing locked (owner: Redwood: Lauren/Ben)
- 2026-07-16: PO issued by Novara finance (owner: Novara finance)

Immediate asks for Novara team:
- Please confirm the finance contact (name + email) so we can format the PO-ready quote for their system.
- Confirm whether you want Redwood to send an AWS Marketplace quote in parallel (we can do both).

Attachments: Redwood-SOW-draft.pdf; security-questionnaire-completed.pdf (short-form answers + SOC2 snapshot).

I will also create a short shared Drive folder with the MAP & artifacts and share the link (cc'd in HubSpot). Karthik / Ben — please flag any items you want edited in the SOW before I make it final on 6/25.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

Lauren / Karthik / Ben — thanks for the artifacts and timeline. Quick internal update:

- Legal (me) will kick off the contract review this week and target an internal read by 7/1; we expect to send initial questions the week of 7/6 if any.
- Security (Oliver) will review your questionnaire and confirm acceptance by 7/9.
- Finance: assigning to procurement lead Hannah Liu (hannah.liu@novara-med.com). She will expect a PO-ready quote with firm line items — please send the quote to her and copy procurement@novara-med.com.

We prefer a direct PO path; marketplace is fine as a contingency but let’s treat PO as the primary commercial route. Please go ahead and generate the formal quote with PO fields. If you can deliver that by Friday 6/26 we will route it into our finance queue for the week of 7/13.

Thanks — we’ll loop Hannah into the thread once we have the quote.

Priya Reddy
